title: Psalm 100
opening_line: All people that on earth do dwell,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: All people that on earth do dwell,
text.normalized: All people that on earth do dwell,
text.reading: All people that on earth do dwell,

text.diplomatic: Sing to the LORD with cheerful voice.
text.normalized: Sing to the LORD with cheerful voice.
text.reading: Sing to the LORD with cheerful voice.

text.diplomatic: Him serve with mirth, his praise forth tell,
text.normalized: Him serve with mirth, his praise forth tell,
text.reading: Him serve with mirth, his praise forth tell,

text.diplomatic: Come ye before him and rejoice.
text.normalized: Come ye before him and rejoice.
text.reading: Come ye before him and rejoice.

text.diplomatic: Know that the LORD is God indeed;
text.normalized: Know that the LORD is God indeed;
text.reading: Know that the LORD is God indeed;

text.diplomatic: Without our aid he did us make:
text.normalized: Without our aid he did us make:
text.reading: Without our aid he did us make:

text.diplomatic: We are his flock, he doth us feed,
text.normalized: We are his flock, he doth us feed,
text.reading: We are his flock, he doth us feed,

text.diplomatic: And for his sheep he doth us take.
text.normalized: And for his sheep he doth us take.
text.reading: And for his sheep he doth us take.

text.diplomatic: O enter then his gates with praise,
text.normalized: O enter then his gates with praise,
text.reading: O enter then his gates with praise,

text.diplomatic: Approach with joy his courts unto:
text.normalized: Approach with joy his courts unto:
text.reading: Approach with joy his courts unto:

text.diplomatic: Praise, laud, and bless his name always,
text.normalized: Praise, laud, and bless his name always,
text.reading: Praise, laud, and bless his name always,

text.diplomatic: For it is seemly so to do.
text.normalized: For it is seemly so to do.
text.reading: For it is seemly so to do.

text.diplomatic: For why? the LORD our God is good,
text.normalized: For why? the LORD our God is good,
text.reading: For why? the LORD our God is good,

text.diplomatic: His mercy is for ever sure;
text.normalized: His mercy is for ever sure;
text.reading: His mercy is for ever sure;

text.diplomatic: His truth at all times firmly stood,
text.normalized: His truth at all times firmly stood,
text.reading: His truth at all times firmly stood,

text.diplomatic: And shall from age to age endure.
text.normalized: And shall from age to age endure.
text.reading: And shall from age to age endure.
